name: paper-collage-ad
title_zh: 把产品简报变成一支完整的剪纸拼贴广告片
tagline_zh: 从分镜到配音到成片，一条流水线走完。不用再拼凑提示词、手动对齐镜头，直接拿到可投放的 MP4。
tagline_en: From storyboard to voiceover to final MP4, one pipeline. No more stitching prompts or aligning shots by hand.
desc_en: This skill should be used when the user asks to "做一个剪纸广告", "制作拼贴广告片", "把产品做成纸片定格动画", "做一个有趣的产品广告", "生成半色调剪纸分镜", "把静态拼贴图做成广告视频", "把广告拉长一点", "参考这个声音配音", or wants a complete branded paper-cut advertisement from brief to validated MP4 rather than only prompts or still images.
why_zh: 它不只是生成画面，而是把「简报→分镜→半色调剪纸→逐帧动画→配音→合成」串成闭环，中间每一步都有校验。
why_en: It's not just image generation—it chains brief→storyboard→halftone cutout→frame animation→voiceover→composite, with checks at.
limit_zh: 只认剪纸拼贴这一种视觉风格，且需要你提供产品图或简报；配音必须另给参考音频，否则静音成片。超出此风格或素材缺失。
limit_en: Only paper-cut collage style; requires a product image or brief. Voiceover needs a reference audio or the output is silent. Anything else stops at.
